metadata.core_objective: Establish healthy, self-regulated digital boundaries without relying on constant policing or total bans.
metadata.key_deliverable: Family Digital Wellness Agreement & Tech-Free Zone Map

topics.title: Neurobiology of Screens & Transitions
topics.summary: Understanding dopamine loops and the physiological resistance to sudden disengagement.
key_principles: Screen disengagement causes acute dopamine drops.
Visual warnings and buffer windows reduce fight-or-flight reactions.

topics.title: Digital Mentor Framework
topics.summary: Shifting from stealth surveillance to collaborative boundaries and clear accountability.

activities.title: The Digital Boundary Audit
activities.instructions: Map out high-conflict tech scenarios and assign clear, logical consequences.

tasks.title: Family Digital Wellness Agreement
tasks.action: Co-author a binding device agreement establishing curfews, transition cues, and red-line protocols.

quiz.question: Why does abrupt screen removal often lead to severe emotional outbursts?
options: B) Devices create high dopamine engagement; sudden disconnection triggers a rapid neurological crash and fight-or-flight response.
C) Children do not understand household rules.
D) Screens permanently alter personality traits.

quiz.question: What is the most effective approach for managing nighttime device usage?
options: A) Trusting youth to keep phones under their pillows on silent.
B) Centralizing device charging in a common household area outside of bedrooms overnight.
C) Cutting off household electricity at 10:00 PM.
D) Banning all digital devices until high school graduation.
